component.name: 8BitDo M30 Bluetooth Gamepad
component.summary: Firmware for the 8BitDo M30 Bluetooth Gamepad

description.p: Update your 8BitDo M30 Bluetooth Gamepad to the latest firmware version to enjoy improved performance, new features, and bug fixes.
本次更新包含以下优化与修复：

ul.li: 新增支持 Switch 2 主机。
修复 Switch 模式同时交换按键和切换方向键不能保存的问题。

description.p: This release includes the following improvements and fixes:

ul.li: Fixed the issue of the Controller where the settings cannot be saved when doing the button swapping and D-pad remapping in Switch mode.

screenshot.caption: Hold the Start button for 3 seconds to power off the controller, then press L + R + Start to enter update mode. The power indicator will flash, and then reconnect the controller.
